CustomField.description: Number of days from Submitted to Completed. Blank until completed.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Completed_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Submitted_Date__c)) ), ROUND( (Completed_Date__c - Submitted_Date__c) * 24 / 24, 0), null )
CustomField.label: Total Approval Duration (Days)
